review: We built a skill that saves our accounting team roughly 40 hours of work each quarter. Each quarter we receive 25 reports that our team goes through, does QC, and then creates additional excel and pdfs that we send to our customers. This skill compiles all of those spreadsheets into one master sheet, then breaks it out into individual customer sheets plus pdfs our team reviews. They'll go from 40 hours to maybe 40 minutes on this. This has been HUGE for us.

Six sessions in, I have a working AI system built specifically around how our company operates. I built a brand design skill that styles every output automatically, an email manager that drafts replies in my voice, a 20-article knowledge base that keeps Claude current on my team and communities, and a Friday Pain Points Digest that reads thousands of emails across four mailboxes each week, classifies them, and lands a ranked summary of what's breaking before I start my weekend. I'm saving around 15 hours a week. My team can execute without coming to me for everything.

Holy snap this is so cool. I set Ace, my agent, off to go build two separate cold email campaigns in Instantly and then went downstairs and was chatting with my wife and kids and then I came back up 10 minutes later and had two campaigns sitting in Instantly ready for me to review 🤯

The class value is 100x its cost! By the end of session 2 I built a fully automated workflow for my wife's travel business that takes her note as input and produces beautifully designed mobile-friendly multi-language travel itineraries that later get automatically sent to her clients.

I built a workflow to automate much of the monthly financial close process that will save me several hours each month. I likely would not have built this in a timely manner had I not been enrolled in the program. The program also taught me the 'little things' that go a long way, such as program add-ons, connectors, and building effective and personalized skill files. I highly recommend that those of all experience levels take the plunge.

The AI Builder Bootcamp was a game-changer for my second venture. In just three weeks, I made more progress than I had in the previous three years combined. As a solo business owner, efficiency is everything; this course provided the exact tools I needed to streamline my operations and maximize the quality time I spend with my clients. Most importantly, the work I did during the program led directly to signing my first client! A huge thank you to Nick and the incredible TAs for their support and expertise.

During this class I built four additional websites outside of my portfolio along with multiple workflows and tasks. This class was EXTREMELY helpful in becoming an AI power user within my team and company. It gave me the knowledge and confidence in building everything with AI.
This course was incredible. Instructors and TAs were super hands on. Walked away with real skills to help me grow a side business and optimize my day to day work.

It's great to find a course where you are actually building. That really is the best way to learn this stuff. All the projects and prompts were timely and thoughtfully chosen so they could be relevant to anyone — regardless of what industry you're in. AI is evolving so quickly but Leland keeps up with the latest advancements to be sure that we are staying ahead of the game. That makes me feel like I can trust them. Finally, the TAs and our instructor Nick were so well-organized and had great enthusiasm! I looked forward to each session and I just wish they were longer. See you in Level 2!

What an eye-opening experience. I quickly realized I had only been scratching the surface. The content and structure was fantastic, but what elevated this cohort were the TA's and the instructor Nick. I was so impressed by their enthusiasm, their responsiveness, and the community that was built over the last 3 weeks. I'm excited to sign up for Level 2 soon to continue my growth. Cannot recommend enough.

I went from knowing briefly about what an agent was to building completed automated workflows. This program completely transformed the way that I see AI from being a buzzword or even detracting from my job to something enhancing.

This class is going to be such a game-changer for me in how I approach my work and the time I'll now be able to spend actually doing the work I enjoy with my clients. Thank you for presenting a well-laid-out class and making it easy for me to follow. I've been playing around with my builder page and tinkering with it, adding new skills, going through the 'Go Further' sections, and aligning the page to match my company's website.
I built workflows to write content for me for multiple social media platforms. Should save me hours per week!
I've used this course to create many skill workflows that I use every day. It's saved me so much time.
This was the best intro to an agentic-AI course I could've asked for. The layout was phenomenal and enabled me to learn at my own pace.
This program set off so many lightbulbs in my imagination — and I so enjoyed building with great instructors and peers. I'll be back for more! Thank you.
I always thought AI was fairly gimmicky but after taking this course I have learned practical uses of AI that actually help me!
10/10 — so glad it was fast-paced. So many online courses just treat you like you're an idiot, or they're not well prepared and feel like a waste of time. This course was awesome.
